first_public_note: AAAI-22 conference presentation (February 2022) precedes arXiv v1 (2022-04-04); the arXiv v1 is the AAAI camera-ready (AAAI 2022 copyright line on page 1). Window: prior before 2021-08, [concurrent] 2021-08 to 2022-08, [later] after 2022-08.

inherited.M01: No user training action; voiced broadcast word clips (LRW, LRW-1000) and sentences (LRS2, LRS3 pre-train)
inherited.M03: End-to-end training per dataset; LRW-pretrained front-end and LRS2/LRS3 pre-train curriculum for sentences (Afouras et al. 2018 lineage); mixup, random erasing, flipping
inherited.M04: Voiced speech; video alone at test, audio front-end detached
inherited.M05: 2D video lip crop 112x112 (LRW, LRW-1000); paired mel-spectrogram only in training
inherited.M07: No external language model (LRS2); word classification on LRW/LRW-1000
inherited.M11: Benchmark splits, partition not named; homophene pairs chosen with the Cappelletta and Harte viseme map, no per-word counts
inherited.M13: Offline; no latency, parameter or compute report for the memory

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept: lip-reading and video-to-speech studies that take only lip or face video at test and use paired audio or a speech model during training to enrich the visual model (distillation, audio-feature regression, memory of audio representations). For this review the population is dated against 2022-02 and filtered to decoders that transfer audio: perception studies, AVSR models needing audio at test, video-to-speech systems with audio only as output target, and distillation between video models are excluded (list in dated_pattern_counts).
topics.metric: LRW word accuracy, higher better; LRS2 WER without LM, lower better

topics.inclusion_rule: Lip-reading decoders (word or sentence level, video only at test) whose ledger names homophenes, visemes, visually similar words or one-to-many mapping; classified by the full-text mechanism named for the ambiguity: multi-head memory, audio memory, viseme intermediate units, language model, audio supervision. Boundary: full-text counts are mentions (pattern match, upper bounds, related work included); surveys, datasets and perception studies excluded from the dated population; versions count once.
topics.pattern: lip reading AND (homophen | viseme | visually similar | one-to-many) in ledger text

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept (visual-only LRW top-1; word-boundary results labelled).
